title: Doosukeltha
desc: Chinna lands in a hospital due to a sting operation he conducted. He falls for Dr. Alekhya. But her life is in danger too. He decides to help her.

title: Premisthe
desc: Aishwarya, a wealthy young student, falls in love with Murugan, a scooter mechanic, and persuades him to elope. Their plans take a dangerous turn when her family tracks them down.

title: Inkokkadu
desc: A suspended RAW agent lives in despair after losing his wife in the hands of a deadly drug lord. Four years later, it's time to avenge her death as his arch nemesis returns.

title: Pushpaka Vimanam
desc: Sundar, a quiet teacher, hopes for a happy marriage. But his life crumbles when his wife leaves him, forcing him to face heartbreak and rebuild himself.
